artworks.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign the referenced existing Milo river-crossing concept image into a polished playable UI concept for the same Chinese 2D Godot tavern game 致未归的客人. This is an art-direction preview, not a screenshot of shipped functionality.
Reference 1 is the edit target: preserve its warm hand-painted western harbor tavern identity, realistic illustrated wood/brass/parchment textures and blue-green river. Reference 2 is the material/lighting reference, not a layout to duplicate.
Landscape 16:9, high resolution. First-person slightly overhead view of a beautifully crafted river-crossing tabletop diorama resting on a real worn walnut tavern table. No human hands. Broad central playfield 80% screen, river vertical from distant to foreground, broken small bridge in distance, rocky banks with fences and docks. Detailed walnut ferry, clear TWO seats, blue-green water, readable silhouettes. Make the river like water with soft highlights, never a flat teal rectangle. Figurines are painted carved wood with visible edge grain and small round bases, not generic round counters.
Exact safe setup: LEFT bank has THREE blue-coated patrol figurines with star badges AND TWO rust-coated worker figurines with shovel emblems. ONE rust-coated worker is seated in the LEFT-docked boat. RIGHT bank is EMPTY. TOTAL only SIX figurines. Empty second boat seat has a subtle pale ochre silhouette indicating valid drop; a small bright cream pointer near it. Avoid extra people anywhere. A handwritten paper counter on each bank: left "岸边 5 人", right "对岸 0 人"; small boat tag "1 / 2". Lower-left boat gently leans toward occupied seat, small concentric ripples, rope slack.
Compact upper-left parchment title "把路画到家" and subtitle "米洛 · 雨后渡口". Upper-right small brown buttons "暂停" and "返回手帐". Under title one unobtrusive rule note "船载 1–2 人；有巡路员的一岸，在押人数不能更多。". A folded map and compass at bottom-left, a small Milo portrait medallion bottom-right based on reference male face (dark hat, moustache, red bandana), plus handwritten quote "别忘了安排回来的那一趟。" Keep portrait small and away from playfield.
At bottom a single clear ivory action strip with dark brown type: "拖动上船 · 空格开船 · Z 撤回 · H 提示". Tiny corner mark "美术概念 · 参数待试玩".
No global coins/time/business toolbar, no huge sidebar, no modern neon, no paper filling the whole scene, no excessive bloom, no flat mobile buttons, no photoreal hands. Foreground objects have grounded contact shadows. Beautiful painterly fidelity matching references, generous readable spaces.

现有研发桌面：材质光照参考

artworks.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign the referenced existing Hank shadow theater minigame concept into a polished gameplay art preview for Chinese game 致未归的客人. Reference 1 is the edit target; preserve its original wood shadow theater, western harbor tavern, warm brass lantern and textured paper story mood. Reference 2 supplies wood, amber lighting and hand-painted fidelity.
Landscape 16:9 high resolution. A finely carved compact shadow theater stands on the first-person tavern table, no hands. Three separated horizontal roads at TOP MIDDLE BOTTOM on layered painted blue-gray paper mountains, soft windblown dust, simple highly readable traveler cutout silhouettes. Center-right ONE brass lantern slides on a vertical wooden/brass rail with three stops; the only real lantern on this rail is currently at MIDDLE. Ghost ring sockets at top and bottom are unlit, not extra lanterns. A warm pool of light spreads leftwards across the middle crossing, clean soft-edged cone with little dust motes. On RIGHT a single shared warm lit refuge/warehouse with three entrance openings aligned with the roads. On LEFT safe waiting shelters.
Show exactly one current active traveler in MIDDLE approaching the lit crossing, hand raised; feet grounded on roadway, half the path ahead has visible warm light. Include a small hanging cloth signal at that road for color-independent cue. Upper-left little parchment "已接回 3 / 6"; center title "风里还有一盏灯" subtitle "老霍克 · 接人回家"; upper right "暂停" and "返回手帐". A second small waiting figure on top-left may be a preview silhouette visibly behind shelter but no crowd. Three tiny brass nameplates on theater base: "玛莎的灯" "齐恩的油" "尼尔的路".
Main playable stage takes 80% screen; small familiar Hank face vignette bottom-right (older white moustache, brown western hat and cream neckerchief as reference), concise quote "看见招手，就把灯送过去。". Bottom cream action ribbon high contrast dark ink "拖动提灯 · ↑↓ 切换灯位 · 照稳后，旅人自动通过". A thin half-filled radial bracket near middle lantern shows holding progress, elegant diegetic brass, not bright UI disc. Tiny corner caption "美术概念 · 参数待试玩".
No global currency/day HUD, no dense rule sidebar, no horror, no black crush, no bloom washing out traveler, no cartoon neon, no big warning exclamation floating over everything. Rich tactile hand-painted cloth, woodgrain, brass and glass matching original references. Strategic readable highlights, nuanced friendly twilight.
reference_roles: 旧影戏概念：重设计目标

artworks.prompt: Create a landscape 16:9 polished hand-painted GAME UI CONCEPT for a Chinese warm western harbor tavern game. First-person top-down over honey walnut table and sage green felt. No human hands. A large open engraved brass pocket watch in center fills 65 percent screen. Inside movement is a readable 3 by 3 arrangement of nine small brass component plates with tiny gear trains and visible adjoining axle connections; one plate is lifted at a cursor, small curved arrow indicates turning the entire plate. Connected train softly catches amber light, unconnected gears remain still. Source mainspring left, targets second-hand shaft and balance wheel right, labels 发条 / 秒针 / 摆轮. This is a stylized mechanical connection puzzle inspired by rotate-network logic, NOT memory buttons. Small cream title upper left 慢半拍的下午 with subtitle 艾达 · 机芯复位. Right tray holds three brass spare modules. Small portrait of red-haired cowgirl with brown hat, faded blue shirt and orange neck scarf. Bottom ivory instructions 拖动组件 · 空格旋转 · 松手装入 · Z 撤回. Warm painterly brass and wood texture, grounded shadows, readable dark brown Chinese text, soft afternoon lighting, neat tactile desk, no neon, no timer, no huge buttons, no black crush. Tiny corner label 玩法概念 · 尚未实现. Show an interesting coherent play area, not a collection of icons.
